title: Implement bf update command
description: Implement the bf update command that modifies bead properties. Acceptance: bf update <bead-id> --status <status> updates status, bf update --title <title> updates title, bf update --description <desc> updates description, validates bead ID exists, writes to SQLite database with transaction.

title: Implement bf show command
description: Implement the bf show command that displays bead details. Acceptance: bf show <bead-id> shows all bead fields, bf show --format json returns structured JSON, validates bead ID exists, reads from SQLite database.

title: Test bead dependencies and close
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create two test beads: bead-a and bead-b
- Use 'bf dep add blocker bead-b --blocks bead-a' to create dependency
- Verify with 'bf show bead-a' that bead-b is listed as a blocker
- Use 'bf close bead-b --reason "Test close"' to close bead-b
- Verify bead-b status is 'done'
- Verify bead-a is no longer blocked
- Clean up: close bead-a after verification

This tests dependency management and bead closing functionality.

title: Implement bf count command
description: Implement the bf count command that counts beads. Acceptance: bf count returns total number of beads, optionally filters by status, reads from SQLite database, returns integer count.

title: Verify bf CLI basic commands work
description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Run `bf --help` and verify it outputs usage information
- Run `bf --version` or `bf version` and verify version output
- Run `bf list` and verify it executes without error
- All commands should return exit code 0

title: Test bead update and status changes
description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Update bead title with `bf update <id> --title 'New title'`
- Update bead status to 'in_progress' with `bf update <id> --status in_progress`
- Update bead status to 'done' with `bf update <id> --status done`
- Verify all updates persist with `bf show <id>`

title: Add --help flag to bf CLI
description:
Implement the --help flag in the bead-forge CLI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a --help flag to src/cli/mod.rs  
- Should show usage information for all commands
- Test with: ./target/debug/bf --help

title: Implement bf list command
description: Implement the bf list command that lists beads. Acceptance: bf list --format json returns array of beads, bf list (default) returns text table, filters by status/priority if flags provided, reads from SQLite database.

title: Implement bf close command
description: Implement the bf close command that closes beads. Acceptance: bf close <bead-id> --reason <reason> sets status to closed, stores close reason, validates bead ID exists, writes to SQLite database with transaction, returns success confirmation.

title: Test bead display and query
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Use 'bf show <id>' to display a bead's full details
- Verify output includes all fields: title, description, status, priority, labels
- Test 'bf list' to show all beads in the workspace
- Verify list includes the test bead created in child bead
- Exit code 0 for all commands

This tests reading and querying bead data from the CLI.

title: Add --version flag to bf CLI
description:
Implement the --version flag in the bead-forge CLI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a --version flag to src/cli/mod.rs
- Output should include 'bf' and version information
- Test with: ./target/debug/bf --version

title: Verify CLI basic commands work
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Run 'bf --help' and verify help text displays without error
- Run 'bf --version' (if supported) or 'bf --help' shows version info
- Exit code is 0 for both commands
- No error messages in stderr

This is a basic sanity check that the CLI is installed and functional before testing more complex operations.

title: Test bead update operations
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create a test bead to update
- Use 'bf update <id> --status blocked' to change status
- Use 'bf update <id> --priority 0' to change priority
- Use 'bf comment <id> --text "Test comment"' to add a comment
- Verify each update with 'bf show <id>' that the change persisted
- Clean up: close the test bead after verification

This tests the update and comment functionality of the CLI.

title: Implement bf create command
description: Implement the bf create command that creates new beads. Acceptance: bf create --title <title> --type <type> --priority <priority> --description <desc> creates a new bead, returns bead ID on success, stores bead in SQLite with correct schema, validates required arguments, handles errors gracefully.

title: Test bead creation and listing
description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Create a test bead with `bf create --title 'Test bead'`
- Verify bead appears in `bf list` output
- Verify bead can be shown with `bf show <id>`
- Clean up test bead after verification

title: Test bead creation
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create a test bead using 'bf create --title "Test bead" --description "Test description"'
- Verify the command succeeds (exit code 0)
- Verify the bead is created by running 'bf show <id>' with the returned ID
- The bead shows the correct title and description
- Clean up: close the test bead after verification

This tests the core create functionality of the CLI.

title: Write and run CLI smoke test script
description:
Write test_bf_test1.sh script to verify bf CLI is functional.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Create test_bf_test1.sh that checks:
  - bf binary exists at ./target/debug/bf
  - bf --help succeeds and shows bead-forge
  - bf --version succeeds and shows version
- Script should exit 0 on success, 1 on failure
- Run the test and verify it passes

## Note
The test script already exists at test_bf_test1.sh - verify it works correctly.
